=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/resolve_integration_ref.sh:586-594 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: resolve_ci_reissue_base_branch calls retarget_merged_base.sh (line 587) without pinning RETARGET_MERGED_BASE_ENABLED / RETARGET_MERGED_BASE_MAX_HOPS. When the caller has RETARGET_MERGED_BASE_ENABLED=false, the helper (retarget_merged_base.sh:110-112) prints the deleted input branch unchanged, the target = default_branch check at line 589 fails, and the resolver refuses with branch_missing at line 593.
  WHY: Only implement.yml:607 and review_autofix.yml:640 export the variable; plan.yml, clarify.yml, validate.yml and orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml do not. With the variable set to false, plan resolves the re-issue to the default branch (outcome=skipped reason=base_branch_merged_into_default), but implement exits 3 (branch_missing) and implement.yml lines 751-753 then run exit 1, so the approved re-issue can never be implemented. The previous editor summary (entry[2]) claims this pin was added, but it is not on the current head. Severity disagreement: minimax_minimax-m3 rated it BLOCKER; the other four rated it MAJOR. The highest is used.
- scripts/resolve_integration_ref.sh:585-595 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Three different outcomes all become the same hard branch_missing refusal (exit 3): a missing helper script, a failed helper lookup, and a genuinely abandoned branch. On a failed lookup, the fail-open helper (retarget_merged_base.sh:54-57,114-118) logs reason=lookup_failed, prints the input branch and exits 0. The resolver discards the helper's stderr and has no branch_lookup_failed mapping.
  WHY: The helper makes raw gh api calls (retarget_merged_base.sh:54, 64), not gh_api_retry. A transient 5xx, network error or secondary rate limit therefore produces exit 3 instead of a retryable exit 75. The changelog then tells the operator to "Recreate the branch", which is the wrong remedy. The previous editor summary (entry[2]) claims a branch_lookup_failed mapping and a lookup_failed fixture were added; neither exists on the current head.
- scripts/resolve_integration_ref.sh:580-594 (agents.d/ci-reissue-merged-pr-base-branch-routing.md lines 2-4) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The agents.d fragment documents "a missing helper, a failed lookup or any other target refuses with `branch_missing`". It gives one operator remedy ("Recreate the branch") for three runtime cases, and that remedy is correct for only one of them.
  WHY: A failed lookup is the most common transient failure path. Operators will recreate a branch that already exists, which wastes time and makes the git history confusing.
- tests/fixtures/integration_ref_resolver_ci_triage/reissue_merged_pr_base_branch_missing_refuses.json:fixture body (tests/test_resolve_integration_ref_ci_triage.py line 272) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The fixture expects branch_missing but has no merged_pulls_by_head entry. The self-test gh mock (lines 857-867) therefore prints "unsupported endpoint" and exits 2, so the fixture exercises the lookup-failed path, not an abandoned branch.
  WHY: A passing CI gate on this fixture does not prove the abandoned-branch path works, and no fixture covers "lookup succeeded, no merged PR". anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash note the same fixture gap inside their lookup-failure findings.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: PR title "Run CI-failure re-issues on the branch that holds the failing code". Re-issue routing must work end-to-end in every workflow that invokes the resolver. The resolver should refuse with branch_missing only when the branch is genuinely abandoned, and should emit CI_TRIAGE_PR_BRANCH_ROUTING ... outcome=skipped reason=base_branch_merged_into_default when the deleted branch was merged into the default branch.
  expected_change_site: scripts/resolve_integration_ref.sh line 587 (helper call env pin); scripts/resolve_integration_ref.sh lines 586-594 (lookup_failed vs branch_missing split); tests/fixtures/integration_ref_resolver_ci_triage/reissue_merged_pr_base_branch_lookup_failed_refuses.json (new fixture)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: line 587 calls the helper without pinning RETARGET_MERGED_BASE_ENABLED=true RETARGET_MERGED_BASE_MAX_HOPS=3, lookup-failed is collapsed into the branch_missing refusal at line 593, there is no reissue_merged_pr_base_branch_lookup_failed_refuses.json fixture, and the "branch_missing" fixture actually triggers the lookup-failed path through the self-test gh mock (lines 857-867)
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/resolve_integration_ref.sh:586-587 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: In the branch_state 1 arm, `target="$(bash "${SCRIPT_DIR}/retarget_merged_base.sh" resolve "${REPO}" "${ref}" "${default_branch}")" || target=""` inherits RETARGET_MERGED_BASE_ENABLED / RETARGET_MERGED_BASE_MAX_HOPS. When the switch is "false", scripts/retarget_merged_base.sh lines 110-112 print the input branch, target equals ref, and the resolver refuses with branch_missing at line 593.
  WHY: Only implement.yml (line 607, inherited by the resolver run at lines 713-718) sets the variable; plan.yml, clarify.yml, validate.yml and orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml do not. Plan resolves to the default branch, implement gets exit 3, and implement.yml lines 751-753 run exit 1. The pin claimed in editor summary entry[2] is not on the current head. Fix: prefix the call with RETARGET_MERGED_BASE_ENABLED=true RETARGET_MERGED_BASE_MAX_HOPS=3.
- scripts/resolve_integration_ref.sh:585-594 (scripts/retarget_merged_base.sh lines 54-57 and 114-118; self-test gh mock lines 857-867; tests/fixtures/integration_ref_resolver_ci_triage/reissue_merged_pr_base_branch_missing_refuses.json) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fail-open helper (raw gh api) logs reason=lookup_failed, prints the input branch and exits 0. The resolver cannot tell this apart from an abandoned branch, and both reach ci_triage_refuse "branch_missing" at line 593.
  WHY: A transient 5xx, network error or secondary rate limit gives exit 3 instead of exit 75, and the "Recreate the branch" remedy is wrong. The branch_missing fixture has no merged_pulls_by_head, so the mock (lines 862-865) returns "unsupported endpoint" (exit 2) and the fixture exercises lookup failure. The branch_lookup_failed mapping, null-means-empty mock and lookup_failed fixture claimed in entry[2] are absent. Fix (~10 lines): capture the helper's stderr and refuse with branch_lookup_failed; make the mock treat null as an empty success; add a lookup-failure fixture.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. There is no linked issue, and both PR-title deliverables are in the diff. Gemini's pass-1 TASK_GAP is refuted.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (3 related items; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3): (1) line 587: pin the env vars, capture stderr, refuse with branch_lookup_failed, ~8 lines. (2) Self-test mock lines 862-865: tell a missing key apart from an explicit null, and add a null entry to reissue_merged_pr_base_branch_missing_refuses.json, ~6 lines. (3) tests/test_codex_isolated_exec.py near test_solc_install_rejects_untrusted_listing_and_inputs: test that the AllowedHostRedirect off-host redirect raises ValueError, ~5 lines.
- Refuted pass-1 items (2 related items): gemini lines 574-577 (a non-default target refuses, which fails closed and matches the contract); minimax branch_state 3 mapped to branch_missing (predates the last run's semantics and is a GitHub-side anomaly).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/resolve_integration_ref.sh:586-594 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The retarget_merged_base.sh call in resolve_ci_reissue_base_branch inherits RETARGET_MERGED_BASE_ENABLED and MAX_HOPS. When the switch is false, the helper prints the input branch, which the resolver treats as a missing branch (branch_missing).
  WHY: With the repository variable set to false, plan routes the re-issue to the default branch but implement refuses with exit 3, so the approved plan is never implemented.
- scripts/resolve_integration_ref.sh:586-595 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The resolver merges three failure modes into the branch_missing refusal: a genuinely missing branch, a lookup failure, and a missing helper script.
  WHY: A transient API error produces a misleading refusal that tells the operator to recreate a branch that may already exist, instead of allowing a retry or giving an accurate diagnosis.
